'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Israel–Hamas war]]
***Two [[US Congress|congressional]] [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]] agree to sign a $18 billion weapon package for [[Israel]] including 50 [[McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle|F-15 Eagle fighter jets]] after initially delaying proceedings, following heavy pressure from the [[Biden Administration]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/two-key-democrats-us-congress-approve-major-arms-sale-israel-washington-post-2024-06-18/ (Reuters)]
**Eight [[Palestinian]]s are killed by [[Israel]]i fire while waiting for commercial trucks in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-fire-kills-8-palestinians-amongst-merchants-civil-guards-waiting-2024-06-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Hezbollah]] commander Muhammad Ahmed Ayoub is allegedly killed in an [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] in [[Selaa]], [[Lebanon]], with further strikes occurring against Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-hamas-war/article-806608 (''Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Russian botulism outbreak]]
**At least 139 people suffer from [[botulism]] in [[Russia]] believed to be caused by eating ready-made [[salad]]s, leading to a nationwide recall of the salads. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-botulism-outbreak-salads-725b9cea0218c1a07c6c476388fda248 (AP)]
*[[2024 West Bengal train collision]]
**Eleven people are killed and sixty others are injured when a cargo train collides with a [[Kanchanjungha Express]] passenger train in [[Darjeeling district]], [[West Bengal]], [[India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/17/up-to-15-reported-killed-in-indian-train-collision (Al Jazeera)]
*At least ten people are killed after two boats carrying migrants shipwreck off the southern coast of [[Italy]], with 64 additional people reported missing. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-calabria-migrants-shipwreck-missing-dead-frontex-901e21b09c9b136bbd7a418ce3bb2019 (AP)]
*[[Egypt]]'s Tourism Hajj Mission announces that at least eight Egyptian pilgrims have died during the [[Hajj]] in [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1236/525651/Egypt/Health/Eight-Egyptian-tourist-pilgrims-pass-away-in-Hajj-.aspx (Ahram)]
*Seven people are killed amid heavy rains across [[El Salvador]]. [https://apnews.com/article/el-salvador-rain-landslide-1ce6d6cd804dbd8f446292279dcfa50e (AP)]
*Six people, including three children, are killed in a house fire in [[Newnan, Georgia|Newnan]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]], and five others are hospitalized. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/6-dead-5-hurt-devastating-georgia-house-fire/story?id=111186227 (ABC News)]
*A person is killed and eight others are injured during an [[Cooking off|ammunition explosion]] at a military training area in [[Město Libavá|Libavá]], [[Czech Republic]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ammunition-explosion-czech-millitary-training-3791553bcf86e2dffbbf913dc435e336 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belgium–France relations]]
**[[France]] and [[Belgium]] announce they are strengthening their cooperation in land defence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-belgium-strengthen-their-cooperation-land-defence-2024-06-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Germany–Poland relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Poland|Polish Prime Minister]] [[Donald Tusk]] orders [[Germany]] to explain a recorded incident where German police appear to desert a migrant family in [[Osinów Dolny]], [[Poland]], just east of the [[Germany–Poland border]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/poland-confronts-germany-over-migrant-border-drop-off-df015f39 (''Barron's'')]
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] announces that he will [[List of international presidential trips made by Vladimir Putin|visit]] [[North Korea]] this week, the first [[state visit]] by a [[Russia]]n President in 24 years. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/17/russias-putin-to-visit-north-korea-for-the-first-time-in-24-years (Al Jazeera)]

**In the United States, [[Governor of Maryland|Maryland Governor]] [[Wes Moore]] [[pardon]]s more than 175,000 people with low-level [[marijuana]] convictions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/maryland-governor-pardons-over-175000-low-level-marijuana-convictions-2024-06-17/ (Reuters)]
